sources.title: GitHub - zai-org/GLM-OCR: GLM-OCR: Accurate × Fast × Comprehensive
sources.snippet: Model Introduction GLM-OCR is a multimodal OCR model for complex document understanding, built on the GLM-V encoder-decoder architecture. It introduces Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) loss and stable full-task reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency, recognition accuracy, and generalization.

sources.title: GLM-OCR-GGUF: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: GLM-OCR-GGUF is an optical character recognition model converted to GGUF quantized format for efficient local inference. Maintained by ggml-org, this model originates from zai-org's GLM-OCR and is designed to run through llama-server with minimal resource requirements.
